name: PSTACK
tagline: 52 working-method skills for engineering, writing and thinking
description: PSTACK is a pack of working methods: sketch before code, prove it works, attack the premise, subtract before you add. Each skill teaches one discipline an agent applies on request or on its own — architect, tdd, unslop, technical-writing, and the full set of principles. Install once; every skill lands in the agent's workspace as its own folder.

prompts.text: Architect this feature before writing any code.
Review this UI copy with the unslop skill and rewrite the slop.
Use the subtract-before-you-add principle to shrink this module.
